pages.text: “Aromatic warmth flows through the throat, dispelling cold and revitalizing the spirit.”$(br2)Ginger Soup is a revitalizing hot drink made by boiling dried ginger pieces with sugar. The golden-hued broth has a mildly spicy yet sweet aftertaste. Drinking it grants Cold Resistance for an extended duration, helping travelers stay warm in snowy environments.

$(br2)$(br)To prepare Ginger Soup, $(br)boil two pieces of dried ginger with sugar.$(br)This drink is highly recommended for snowy expeditions, ensuring that travelers remain warm and active in harsh cold conditions.

Upon drinking Ginger Soup, travelers receive an extended Cold Resistance effect, allowing them to remain unaffected by freezing temperatures.$(br)This is an ideal drink for snowy adventures, ensuring comfort in the ice-covered world.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
